text_block_list.text:
I had been sitting at my desk for a while,
but I was still worried about Marvelous
Sunday. I 
decided to go to the infirmary to check on
her――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Haa…… Haa…… ……Ugh……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mmm…… mmmmm……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh…… Trainer……? 
……Ahaa, seems like, I'm still dreaming……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad…… being alone,
isn't marvelous after all……

Maybe it's because she just woke up,
but Marvelous 
Sunday seemed a little out of it.
Wondering if she was okay,
I talked to her because she seemed
depressed.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm~…… a long time ago……the same dream
I'd had 
while I was hospitalized…… It was dark……in
a place 
where I couldn't see anything…… and very
cold――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I hated being alone,
so I'd just start walking. 
I didn't know where to go,
but I kept moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When I did,
eventually I could see a light far in 
the distance…… A warm looking place……if I
went there,
maybe I'd find someone to hold me tight――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Without realizing it,
I started running. But 
that light kept getting further away…… No
matter how much I wanted to go there,
to reach it――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I ran…… I ran with all my strength…… I just
ran――!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When I opened my eyes,
Papa and Mama were crying. 
Grandma praised me,
saying I had worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous' Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
They told us you might not open your eyes
again. 
But just like your name,
you showed us a wonderful miracle……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous' Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous is a miracle――joy――a wonderous
surprise. 
To us, you just being here is Marvelous,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That was when I realized it――!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Being born, being alive,
running. Just sharing a connection with 
someone,
that that would make everything more joyous
for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That something miraculous,
that wonderful surprises exist! 
Even if you can't see or feel it,
they're all around……!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right! Marvelous is something special,
amazing, a wonderful 
surprise!
That's what I wanted to show Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because showing everyone that kind of
Marvelous is my dream☆ 
That's why I came to Tracen Academy,
after all!

At some point,
the strength had returned to 
her eyes.
Maybe it was because she remembered 
her promise to show me what Marvelous was.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see,
the world is filled with people like
Trainer. 
Lots of people that don't realize what
Marvelous is.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It can't be seen so they don't know…… in
that case, 
I want to show them!
That's why I decided to enter races!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's alot of Marvelous things in races,
after all☆ Passion……excitement……emotions,
and many other special, 
wonderful surprises that can't be found
elsewhere!

A wonderful surprise――if she put it that
way, 
then I felt I could understand what 『Marvelous』
meant.
Like with the waxed hallway――

That Mystery Tea.
You didn't know what flavor it 
had until you drank it.
Marvelous Sunday considered 
all these little surprises to be something
special.

I had thought my life was boring.
But I never even tried 
to see the beauty in everyday life,
thinking that 
I'd be disappointed if the world itself
didn't shine.

But, there were many wonderful surprises in
my life, and I just had 
to look for them. If I did,
then my world would definitely shine!

Whether your days were exciting or
unforgettable, it 
all depended on how you saw it.
Even those days I spent 
thinking and worrying about the meaning of
Marvelous――

Were fun…… those days after coming to Tracen
were fulfilling! 
The thing I found marvelous――the wonderful
surprise, was her!

I wanted the world to know about Marvelous
Sunday. By 
supporting her,
I wanted her feelings to reach everyone.

That the world around you is overflowing 
with marvelous things.
If that's her dream――
choice_data_list: ……Will you let me help with that d...
……Will you let me help with that d...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is going to help!? But, but,
how are you gonna do that!?
choice_data_list: Let me help with your training

text_block_list.text:
Normally,
this kind of talk would be accompanied 
by talks of a contract. But,
if she wanted to show everyone that,
she couldn't stay as she was.

First,
we need to increase her strength so she 
doesn't collapse during training.
If she wanted to 
show everyone what Marvelous was,
it was necessary.

Maybe she'd be dissatisfied if she was told
to hold back.
Maybe it would feel a bit like a 
detour. But,
Marvelous Sunday might understand.

After all, even during that rainy day, 
she was able to find something marvelous――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eh~, how? If it's raining this hard,
we might not be able 
to train tomorrow either,
you know? Maya wants to run!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's true,
if you can't run because it's 
raining, it's boring,
huh?☆ But if you wait, and wait,
and wait a little more for the sun then――

Maybe by holding back on her desire to
run during the rain,
it would make the next time 
she was on the turf that much more
exciting.

If the Marvelous she mentioned on that day
was anything like that,
maybe she'd understand what it meant 
to focus on efficiency to get better results
later.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You'll help me with training!? If you do,
will I be 
able to show that special Marvelous to
everyone!?
choice_data_list: You'll be able to for sure!

text_block_list.text:
Her positivity would be a huge asset.
If she could focus on 
that,
she should be able to aim higher.
Putting it that way――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aim higher for a special Marvelous!
If I show them that, 
then more people will realize what Marvelous
is, right!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want everyone to see it☆ 
A special Marvelous that only I can show
them★☆★

I had Marvelous Sunday take a break――and
then several days 
later.
Once again I was on the training course with
her.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Haa……Haa……――Alright! 
On the next one, I'll use all of――☆

If she went all out here,
nothing would change. 
The first thing she needed to learn was to
manage her pace.
choice_data_list: Just maintain your speed for now!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! ……but, you see Trainer! 
It's strange,
for some reason my heart won't stop
beating!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It just feels like that Marvelous feeling
keeps building up☆ 
If I keep on building this up more and more
then――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
you're right! That's why right now……is 
the time to build up that Marvelous
feeling!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ――Then, Trainer, I'll be off☆

Just as I instructed,
Marvelous Sunday was 
running while maintaining her speed.

It seems like even she felt something from
this training. 
In that case, I had high expectations.
